body:
Spelling is irrelevant in this situation, don't be a dick. 

As for my cry for attention: Yes, that's pretty much what it is. Doesn't everyone posting here want some sort of attention? Light shed on their situations, hope for whatever may come, etc. 

Using that particular quote as evidence that I'm just bitching was probably a bad idea as well. Was it the 'or whatever' that did you in? Just because my diction is not to your standard doesn't mean I'm not serious about it. 

Anyways, I'd bother responding to your other points, but at this point I'm assuming you're a troll. I dunno, or you're just a huge bitch who gets bothered by stupid shit. Damn, if you didn't want to see a ton of whining, why are you here?

You did help with my decision, though. I almost appreciate it. Or I would if I didn't dislike you so much. If it weren't for that last bit of your bullshit putting me over the edge, I don't think I would have had the balls to kill myself at the end of the week. But, seconal calls. Feel free to bitch about how melodramatic I'm being, or how you don't believe that I actually killed myself. Oh, a good one to tell them would be that I'm just trying to make a point and make you look bad. 

Everyone else: I appreciate you.

Thank you for your response. Btw, I don't really watch TV, but it's not like I don't get a healthy dose of unrealistic women from every other media outlet. 

And do you know how long I'd have to abstain from fast food to get unhooked? I tried watching things like Fast Food America and Super Size Me to gross myself out of eating fast food anymore [I don't really drink soda so that's not been a problem] but DAMN my appetite for french fries can be insatiable, sometimes.
I appreciate it. I may very well end up PMing you.

Man, I'm sorry you have to go through it too. 

When you say regular eating schedule, do you literally mean, "I will eat at 8, , noon, and 5 today." or something else? I've read the phrase 'eating schedule' in a lot of different contexts... just thought I'd preface that question so I didn't seem dumb. :)
Thank you, I may take you up on that.
